verdict.rationale: Grafana ships Explore for ad-hoc querying/drilldown across data sources (grafana-gh-1, grafana-gh-2) and documents a dedicated query language, LogQL, with syntax details (grafana-docs-15), alongside general docs on querying/exploring metrics, logs, and traces (grafana-docs-9/23). This matches the developer story of ad hoc telemetry analysis with a documented query language. Missing for 10: deeper first-party documentation of PromQL itself (only Loki's LogQL is directly documented in the pack) and independent corroboration free of usability complaints—one community comment notes documentation gaps around pulling/dashboarding data (grafana-comm-3).
